zones.name: The Twilight Strand
zones.summary: One straight beach into town — zero layout variance.
tips: Kill only what blocks the lane; Hillock guards the town gate and has to die.
Treat it as your movement warm-up: pathing habits here set the tone for the run.

zones.name: The Coast
zones.summary: Long strip between cliffs and sea; progress runs parallel to the water.
tips: Hold the upper (cliff) edge — the Mud Flats exit is at the far end, up the rise.
Waypoint usually sits on the path past the midpoint; tag it in stride.
Tidal Island juts off the beach side — only detour if you're taking Mercy Mission (Quicksilver Flask).

zones.name: The Tidal Island
zones.summary: Small island loop; Hailrake camps the far tip.
tips: Sweep one side of the loop straight to Hailrake, grab the Medicine Chest, then logout/portal back.
The Quicksilver Flask reward is the biggest early movement upgrade — worth the detour on most routes.

zones.name: The Mud Flats
zones.summary: Open flats; three Rhoa mounds hold the glyphs that unlock the way forward.
tips: The mounds ring the middle of the zone — clear the closest three and ignore everything else.
The Submerged Passage door sits on the far edge; the Fetid Pool is a separate dead-end loop.
Rhoa charges are the main death risk this early — keep moving, don't get surrounded.

zones.name: The Fetid Pool
zones.summary: Small bog dead-end loop — purely optional.
tips: If routed: circle the pool one way, clear the ritual mobs, and leave.
On fast runs skip it; the time cost rarely pays for itself.

zones.name: The Submerged Passage
zones.summary: Flooded cave; a plank bridge crosses the chasm mid-zone.
tips: Follow the water channel to the bridge, then push straight to the far stairs (The Ledge).
The Flooded Depths (Deep Dweller, +1 passive) branches off the lower pools — take it while leveling, skip when racing.

zones.name: The Flooded Depths
zones.summary: Compact cave; the Deep Dweller sits in the far pool.
tips: Kill the Dweller and portal out — the turn-in pays a passive skill point.

zones.name: The Ledge
zones.summary: The classic one-lane cliff shelf.
tips: Commit to one direction along the shelf — the exit is at the top end.
Packs tend to come at you from the direction you should be heading; use them as a compass.

zones.name: The Climb
zones.summary: S-shaped mountain trail with one real fork.
tips: Stay on the worn path; the side pockets are loot bait, not progress.
The Lower Prison entrance is the lit gatehouse at the top of the trail.

zones.name: The Lower Prison
zones.summary: Rectangular prison floor; the stairs up sit across the floor from the entrance.
tips: Run the outer corridor instead of threading cells.
Trial of Ascendancy #1 is here — take it now; it's on the Normal lab checklist.

zones.name: The Upper Prison
zones.summary: Cell blocks funneling toward Brutus.
tips: Push forward room to room — Brutus' arena is the far end, and Prisoner's Gate opens behind him.

zones.name: Prisoner's Gate
zones.summary: Canyon road running downhill; everything hangs off the road.
tips: Follow the road — the Ship Graveyard exit is past the gate at the low end.
Tag the waypoint for the Act 6 revisit (it hosts a trial then).

zones.name: The Ship Graveyard
zones.summary: Wide wreck-littered beach — the act's most variable zone.
tips: Hug the waterline instead of weaving between hulls; the Cavern of Wrath entrance reads from far away.
The Ship Graveyard Cave (Allflame / Marooned Mariner, +1 passive) hides among the wrecks — leveling yes, racing no.
If you're lost, pick an edge and commit — wandering the middle is the classic time sink here.

zones.name: The Ship Graveyard Cave
zones.summary: Short cave loop beneath the wrecks.
tips: Finish The Marooned Mariner here for the passive point, then portal out.

zones.name: The Cavern of Wrath
zones.summary: Winding sea cave descending toward Merveil.
tips: Follow the water downhill; at forks the wider tunnel is usually the way.
No waypoint on this level — don't die deep without a portal.

zones.name: The Cavern of Anger
zones.summary: Second cave layer ending at Merveil; Act 2 lies behind her.
tips: Tag the waypoint on the way through, then push to the boss arena.
Clear a small pocket before engaging Merveil on squishier builds — her adds punish clutter.

zones.name: The Southern Forest
zones.summary: Forest road along the river, straight up to the Encampment.
tips: Stay on the road — it runs to the town gate.
Tag the waypoint for the Act 6 return trip.

zones.name: The Old Fields
zones.summary: Broad field between forest walls; Crossroads on the far side.
tips: Cross roughly straight — the exit is opposite your entrance more often than not.
The Den pops up mid-field; enter only if your route uses it.

zones.name: The Den
zones.summary: Burrow loop with the Great White Beast at its heart.
tips: It's one ring — pick a direction, kill the Beast, portal out.

zones.name: The Crossroads
zones.summary: Four-way hub under the ruined aqueduct — the act's junction.
tips: Waypoint at the central crossing; tag it before any branch.
North bridge → Broken Bridge (Kraityn). Uphill ruins → Chamber of Sins. South road → Fellshrine and the Crypt.

zones.name: The Broken Bridge
zones.summary: Short dead-end at the collapsed span; Kraityn camps it.
tips: Straight shot along the road — resolve Kraityn per your bandit plan and leave.

zones.name: The Fellshrine Ruins
zones.summary: Road to a ruined church; the Crypt sits beneath it.
tips: Follow the road, not the woods — the church is at the far end and the Crypt entrance is in its yard.

zones.name: The Crypt Level 1
zones.summary: Dark indoor maze; Trial of Ascendancy inside.
tips: Hug one wall — rooms loop back on themselves; the trial and the stairs sit deep, away from the entrance.
Normal-lab checklist stop: don't leave without the trial.

zones.name: The Crypt Level 2
zones.summary: Small burial level with the sealed chest chamber at the bottom.
tips: Dead end — only descend if your route takes the optional chest quest.

zones.name: The Chamber of Sins Level 1
zones.summary: Rectangular temple floor; the stairwell hides along the outer wall.
tips: Run the perimeter until the stairs appear — the middle is a time sink.
Waypoint at the entrance is a useful act anchor.

zones.name: The Chamber of Sins Level 2
zones.summary: Fidelitas' floor; a Trial of Ascendancy shares it.
tips: Sweep for the green-lit trial door while heading to Fidelitas; kill him for the Baleful Gem and portal out.

zones.name: The Riverways
zones.summary: Long river road that forks the act: Western Forest ahead, Wetlands across.
tips: Stay on the road; the waypoint marks the fork.
Western Forest side handles Alira/Weaver business; Wetlands continues the main quest.

zones.name: The Western Forest
zones.summary: Road zone — everything hangs off the road.
tips: Alira's camp is off one side of the road, the Weaver's cave off the other; don't leave the road otherwise.
Blackguard ambushes cluster at the road's pinch points.

zones.name: The Weaver's Chambers
zones.summary: Spider tunnels down to the Weaver.
tips: Mostly a single descending path — kill the Weaver, take Maligaro's Spike, portal.
Know your 'Sharp and Cruel' support gem pick before the turn-in.

zones.name: The Wetlands
zones.summary: Swamp basin; Oak's camp is the central island.
tips: The waypoint sits by Oak — handle your bandit choice in passing.
The Vaal Ruins entrance is on the far side of the swamp from where you entered.

zones.name: The Vaal Ruins
zones.summary: Buried corridors; the Ancient Seal blocks the midpoint.
tips: Smash the seal and keep moving — it's a winding corridor, not a maze.
Follow the wall torches; the dark hides ledge drops.

zones.name: The Northern Forest
zones.summary: Cliffside forest rising toward the Caverns.
tips: Climb — the Caverns entrance is uphill along the cliff wall.
Dread Thicket branches mid-zone; it's optional in this act.

zones.name: The Dread Thicket
zones.summary: Fern maze — optional in Act 2.
tips: Skip on speed runs. If you must: wall-hug; it's a ring with pockets.

zones.name: The Caverns
zones.summary: Twisting crystal cave to the Ancient Pyramid.
tips: Prefer the descending tunnel at forks; the Pyramid door is the deepest point.
Tag the mid-cave waypoint before committing to the boss push.

zones.name: The Ancient Pyramid
zones.summary: Stacked floors up to the Vaal Oversoul on the roof.
tips: Stairs chain corner to corner — sweep each floor's edge for the next flight.
The Act 3 exit is past the boss; no backtracking needed.

zones.name: The City of Sarn
zones.summary: Bridge entry into the ruined city; the town gate is across the district.
tips: Follow the main avenue — Clarissa's event and the gate are at the far side.
Don't clear the city; packs thin as you near the gate.

zones.name: The Slums
zones.summary: Streets linking town to the Crematorium, with the sewer grate mid-district.
tips: The Crematorium sits at the far corner — cut the diagonal through courtyards.
Note the sewer entrance as you pass; you come back with the keys.

zones.name: The Crematorium
zones.summary: Industrial interior; Trial of Ascendancy plus the Tolman story room.
tips: Take the trial while sweeping — it's on the Normal lab checklist.
Portal out after the Piety scene instead of walking back.

zones.name: The Sewers
zones.summary: Three-armed sewer network between the Slums and the Marketplace.
tips: Follow the waterway — the far ladder surfaces at the Marketplace.
Victario's three platinum busts sit one per arm; grab them only if your route wants that turn-in.

zones.name: The Marketplace
zones.summary: Market blocks and courtyards; two onward exits.
tips: The Battlefront exit is on the far street edge; the Catacombs (trial) hide in a courtyard.
Navigate by street intersections — the stall interiors all look alike.

zones.name: The Catacombs
zones.summary: Compact crypt holding a Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: Wall-hug to the trial and leave — there's nothing else down here.

zones.name: The Battlefront
zones.summary: Open siege field; Docks at the waterline, Solaris gate across the field.
tips: Tag the waypoint on the main road — two quest runs fan out from here.
The Docks entrance is the pier at the water's edge; Solaris Temple is the monumental gate opposite.

zones.name: The Solaris Temple Level 1
zones.summary: Bright marble halls with generous corridors.
tips: Near-linear — take the grand staircases and keep moving.

zones.name: The Solaris Temple Level 2
zones.summary: Second Solaris floor; Dialla at the top.
tips: Same drill as Level 1 — staircase to staircase; portal out after the quest hand-off.

zones.name: The Docks
zones.summary: Night-time timber maze on the water; the Sulphite pickup.
tips: Head to the far pier line first, then sweep laterally for the Sulphite warehouse.
Accept that this is one of the campaign's worst layouts — bank the pickup and portal straight out.

zones.name: The Ebony Barracks
zones.summary: Military yard; Gravicius mid-camp, Lunaris gate up the stairs.
tips: Cut straight through the parade ground — Gravicius stands in the open.
Tag the waypoint by the Lunaris steps before the Piety push.

zones.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 1
zones.summary: Dark mirror of Solaris; a corridor spine with side labs.
tips: Stay on the main-hall spine; ignore the side laboratories.

zones.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 2
zones.summary: Piety's floor.
tips: Spine to the far end, kill Piety, portal — the walk back is pure waste.

zones.name: The Imperial Gardens
zones.summary: Formal gardens with a hedge maze; trial plus the Library branch.
tips: Navigate by the Sceptre of God — the tower gate is visible from almost anywhere.
The Trial of Ascendancy sits by the hedge maze; take it in passing (last of the Normal six for many routes).
The Library detour is only for unlocking Siosa's gem shop.

zones.name: The Library
zones.summary: Grand hall — Siosa's quest hub with the Archives below.
tips: Talk to Siosa, then only descend for the Golden Pages if your route wants the gem vendor.

zones.name: The Archives
zones.summary: Book-stack maze holding the four Golden Pages.
tips: Pages sit in separate wings — wall-follow and watch for the glowing pickups.
Pure side content; budget it consciously or skip.

zones.name: The Sceptre of God
zones.summary: Tower ascent; stairwells chain upward.
tips: Per floor: find the next stair, ignore the wings — no waypoint mid-tower, so commit.

zones.name: The Upper Sceptre of God
zones.summary: Final floors to Dominus' rooftop.
tips: Linear once the stair chain starts; Dominus has two phases — bank a portal before engaging if unsure.
The Act 4 exit is on the rooftop past the fight.

zones.name: The Aqueduct
zones.summary: Straight water channel to Highgate.
tips: It's a corridor — run it; nothing here is worth stopping for.

zones.name: The Dried Lake
zones.summary: Big cracked bowl; Voll near the middle; dead-end zone.
tips: Sweep a shallow arc — Voll's arena mound stands above the flats and reads from a distance.
Kill Voll, then portal/waypoint back; the story continues from Highgate.

zones.name: The Mines Level 1
zones.summary: Rail tunnels; the tracks are the route.
tips: Follow the rails to the Level 2 shaft; treat side galleries as dead ends.

zones.name: The Mines Level 2
zones.summary: Deeper galleries; Deshret's spirit breaks the way onward.
tips: Find the banner/spirit chamber on the main line, trigger it, and keep descending to the Crystal Veins.
At junctions prefer the tunnel that goes down.

zones.name: The Crystal Veins
zones.summary: Small hub cave: waypoint, Dialla, and both Dream portals.
tips: Tag the waypoint immediately.
Kaom's and Daresso's sides can be run in either order — pick by what your build handles better (lava ledges vs arena packs).

zones.name: Kaom's Dream
zones.summary: Lava ledges spiraling downward.
tips: Follow the descending ledge line; misjudged drops cost more time than monsters.
The Stronghold door waits at the bottom.

zones.name: Kaom's Stronghold
zones.summary: Kaom's fortress arena — one of the two organ bosses.
tips: Push straight to the throne arena; take the organ and portal back to the Veins.

zones.name: Daresso's Dream
zones.summary: Sword-strewn dreamscape of bridges toward the Grand Arena.
tips: Bridges chain forward — ignore the side stands.
Density spikes at chokepoints; don't fight in the narrows on hardcore.

zones.name: The Grand Arena
zones.summary: Colosseum pit chain ending at Daresso — the other organ.
tips: Arena gates open in sequence; kill Daresso, grab the organ, portal out.

zones.name: The Belly of the Beast Level 1
zones.summary: Flesh tunnels — organic corridors that all look alike.
tips: Prefer the widest artery at forks; the way down sits in the deepest chamber.

zones.name: The Belly of the Beast Level 2
zones.summary: Gut corridors to the Harvest.
tips: Keep descending — the Harvest opens past the story scene at the bottom.

zones.name: The Harvest
zones.summary: Malachai's organ garden — hub with waypoint and the Black Core.
tips: Tag the waypoint before anything else.
Malachai is two phases and mobile — bank a portal, clear the arena edges first.

zones.name: The Ascent
zones.summary: Bridge climb out of the mountain toward Act 5's ship.
tips: Pure corridor — just run through the scripted scenery.

zones.name: The Slave Pens
zones.summary: Slaver interior into Oriath; Overseer Krow at the exit yard.
tips: Room chain — keep pushing forward; Krow's yard opens to town.

zones.name: The Control Blocks
zones.summary: Prison block grid; the Miasmeter sits on the main path.
tips: Sweep block to block toward the far gate; the story pickups are on the way, not hidden.

zones.name: Oriath Square
zones.summary: Large plaza district before the Templar complex.
tips: Cross on the diagonal; the Templar Courts entrance is the cathedral facade.
Tag the waypoint — Act 5 loops back through this area's burned versions later.

zones.name: The Templar Courts
zones.summary: Church interior to the Chamber of Innocence.
tips: Stick to the main aisle — side chapels are dead weight.

zones.name: The Chamber of Innocence
zones.summary: Boss floor — Innocence's sanctum.
tips: Fight in the sanctum, then tag the waypoint here: the act revisits this complex after the fall.

zones.name: The Torched Courts
zones.summary: The Templar Courts burning — same bones, reversed traversal.
tips: Run the aisle logic in reverse; fire-side packs hit harder, so keep moving.

zones.name: The Ruined Square
zones.summary: Oriath's plaza after the fall — the act's hub.
tips: Waypoint central; the Reliquary and Ossuary branch off as side vaults, the Cathedral Rooftop continues the story.
Kitava's Torments roam — fight only what stands on your line.

zones.name: The Reliquary
zones.summary: Vault wings around a central rotunda; story pickup inside.
tips: In-and-out side zone: grab the objective, portal back to the Square.

zones.name: The Ossuary
zones.summary: Bone crypt off the Square — optional in this act.
tips: Side vault with a quest objective; wall-hug in, portal out. (Its Trial of Ascendancy only exists in the Act 10 version.)

zones.name: The Cathedral Rooftop
zones.summary: Rooftop approach to the first Kitava fight.
tips: Linear path; the encounter is scripted set-pieces — dodge the slams, burn the phases.
Nothing to backtrack; Act 6 sails right after.

zones.name: The Twilight Strand
zones.summary: The Strand again — hostile the whole way into the Watch.
tips: Same straight beach as Act 1 with higher density; hold the line into town.

zones.name: The Coast
zones.summary: Coast rerun at cruel difficulty.
tips: Act 1 rule holds: cliff edge to the far-end exit, waypoint mid-strip.
Tidal Island is optional again — check your route before detouring.

zones.name: The Tidal Island
zones.summary: Island loop rerun — optional side kill.
tips: Same loop as Act 1; only come for the quest target on the far tip, then portal.

zones.name: The Mud Flats
zones.summary: Flats rerun — no glyphs this time, just cross.
tips: Head for the far edge: the Ridge continues the act; the Karui Fortress is the offshore side zone.
Density is the danger — keep moving through the Rhoa fields.

zones.name: The Karui Fortress
zones.summary: Tukohama's island fort — side zone.
tips: Cross to the fort, kill Tukohama for the 'Father of War' turn-in, portal out.

zones.name: The Ridge
zones.summary: Single ridgeline path — Act 6's answer to the Ledge.
tips: One lane along the crest; the Lower Prison gate is at the top end. Just run.

zones.name: The Lower Prison
zones.summary: Prison rerun.
tips: Outer-corridor rule from Act 1 applies; the stairs lead up to Shavronne's Tower.

zones.name: Shavronne's Tower
zones.summary: Tower floors up to Shavronne.
tips: Stair-chain per floor; after the fight the path drops toward Prisoner's Gate.

zones.name: Prisoner's Gate
zones.summary: The canyon road again — now hosting a Trial of Ascendancy (Cruel lab).
tips: Downhill road rule applies; the trial pocket branches mid-road — it's on the Cruel checklist, take it.
The exit at the bottom opens the Riverways.

zones.name: The Riverways
zones.summary: River road rerun.
tips: Stay on the road; the fork waypoint anchors the act — Wetlands is the way on.

zones.name: The Wetlands
zones.summary: Swamp rerun; Ryslatha nests where Oak camped.
tips: The central island holds Ryslatha ('The Puppet Mistress') — kill in passing.
Far-side exit continues toward the Southern Forest.

zones.name: The Southern Forest
zones.summary: Southern Forest in reverse — from the river toward the Beacon.
tips: Follow the road; the Beacon replaces the town-gate end of Act 1's version.

zones.name: The Beacon
zones.summary: Coastal fort with the signal fire — an up-then-down zone.
tips: Climb the switchbacks, light the beacon, then descend to the shore for Brine King's Reef.
Two phases, one route — don't clear the wings.

zones.name: Brine King's Reef
zones.summary: Tidal causeway to the act boss.
tips: The causeway is linear; the Brine King fight is about respecting the wave/geyser tells.
Act 7 departs right after the kill.

zones.name: The Broken Bridge
zones.summary: The bridge again — now the act's opening crossing.
tips: One road — cross it; the Crossroads exit is on the far side.

zones.name: The Crossroads
zones.summary: The hub rerun; this act routes you south and uphill.
tips: Same central waypoint; you want the Fellshrine road (Crypt trial) and the Chamber of Sins hill (main quest).

zones.name: The Fellshrine Ruins
zones.summary: Church road rerun.
tips: Road to the ruin; the Crypt below now carries a Trial of Ascendancy.

zones.name: The Crypt
zones.summary: Single-level Crypt holding a Cruel-lab Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: Wall-hug to the trial, then portal — nothing else down here.

zones.name: The Chamber of Sins Level 1
zones.summary: Chamber rerun, Level 1.
tips: Perimeter rule to the stairs; Maligaro's Sanctum branches beneath as side content.

zones.name: The Chamber of Sins Level 2
zones.summary: Level 2 — Maligaro's territory, with another Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: Take the trial while sweeping to the story room — it completes most Cruel-lab checklists together with the Crypt and Prisoner's Gate.
The Ashen Fields open beyond.

zones.name: Maligaro's Sanctum
zones.summary: Maligaro's flesh workshop — side zone.
tips: Push to the boss chamber, settle Maligaro, portal out.

zones.name: The Ashen Fields
zones.summary: Burned farmland between the Chamber hill and the Northern Forest.
tips: Cut across on the cart road; the forest gate is on the far side.
Tag the mid-field waypoint.

zones.name: The Northern Forest
zones.summary: Forest rerun; Greust's camp sits on the main path.
tips: Handle the Greust interaction in passing — it gates later act business.
The Causeway exit is the aqueduct end; the Dread Thicket branches for the fireflies.

zones.name: The Dread Thicket
zones.summary: Fern maze rerun — now holding the seven fireflies.
tips: Fireflies glow through the fog — sweep the ring plus pockets until you have all seven.
One of the act's honest time sinks; deliberate practice here pays real seconds.

zones.name: The Causeway
zones.summary: Aqueduct span — linear, with Kishara's Star on the way.
tips: Run the span; the Star pickup sits on the main line — don't leave the bridge for it.
Vaal City at the far end.

zones.name: The Vaal City
zones.summary: Overgrown city hub before Arakaali's temple.
tips: Tag the central waypoint; make sure the act's pickups are done before the temple descent.

zones.name: The Temple of Decay Level 1
zones.summary: Web-choked corridors downward.
tips: Near-linear — follow the webbing down; don't clear the side pockets.

zones.name: The Temple of Decay Level 2
zones.summary: Arakaali's floor — act finale.
tips: Push to the arena; save movement/defensive flasks for her phase transitions.
The Act 8 exit is past the fight.

zones.name: The Sarn Ramparts
zones.summary: City wall approach — a corridor with a view.
tips: Run the wall line to the far tower; the Toxic Conduits drop below.

zones.name: The Toxic Conduits
zones.summary: Sewer junction under Sarn; Doedre's bowl at its heart.
tips: Follow the main sludge line to the Cesspool arena; the city reopens after.

zones.name: Doedre's Cesspool
zones.summary: Doedre's arena bowl.
tips: Boss set-piece — clear the rim first, then fight in the middle; her sigils punish standing still.

zones.name: The Grand Promenade
zones.summary: Elevated boulevard on the Lunaris side of the act.
tips: Straight boulevard; the Bath House sits at the far end.
The High Gardens branch is side content — skip unless routed.

zones.name: The High Gardens
zones.summary: Terraced gardens — optional side zone.
tips: Only enter if your route includes its quest; in, objective, portal.

zones.name: The Bath House
zones.summary: Bathhouse interior holding an Eternal-lab Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: Take the trial — first of the final three.
The exit continues toward the Lunaris Concourse.

zones.name: The Lunaris Concourse
zones.summary: Plaza before Lunaris Temple, with waypoint.
tips: Tag the waypoint; the temple door is the landmark — floors stack above.

zones.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 1
zones.summary: Lunaris rerun, Level 1.
tips: Corridor spine rule — main hall forward, ignore the labs.

zones.name: The Lunaris Temple Level 2
zones.summary: Lunaris rerun, Level 2 — branch objective at the top.
tips: Spine to the top, complete the temple objective, portal down.

zones.name: The Grain Gate
zones.summary: Warehouse gate district opening the Solaris side.
tips: Push through the gate yards toward the Imperial Fields.
Gemling packs cluster at chokepoints — respect them on hardcore.

zones.name: The Imperial Fields
zones.summary: Farm fields before the Solaris Concourse.
tips: Cross on the road; the Concourse gate is far side, and the Quay branches at the water as side content.

zones.name: The Solaris Concourse
zones.summary: Solaris plaza with waypoint.
tips: Tag the waypoint; same temple drill as the Lunaris side.

zones.name: The Solaris Temple Level 1
zones.summary: Solaris rerun, Level 1.
tips: Bright corridor spine — staircases forward.

zones.name: The Solaris Temple Level 2
zones.summary: Solaris rerun, Level 2 — branch objective at the top.
tips: Top floor, objective, portal down — mirror of the Lunaris branch.

zones.name: The Quay
zones.summary: Docks district — optional side zone.
tips: Skip unless your route takes its quest; it's a wandering waterfront otherwise.

zones.name: The Harbour Bridge
zones.summary: Final bridge — Solaris & Lunaris await.
tips: Linear bridge to the arena; the twin fight alternates sun/moon phases — fight from the seam between their zones.
Act 9 sails after.

zones.name: The Blood Aqueduct
zones.summary: The Aqueduct, bloodied — still one straight channel.
tips: Run the channel; it's the campaign's most farmed zone, but on a timed run you're just passing through.

zones.name: The Descent
zones.summary: Cliff switchbacks down from Highgate.
tips: One path down; the Vastiri Desert opens at the bottom.

zones.name: The Vastiri Desert
zones.summary: Open desert crossing with the Oasis side basin.
tips: Head for the far rock wall — the Foothills gate breaks the skyline.
The Oasis is a side basin; enter only if your route takes its quest.
Open-desert zones drift the most — pick a bearing early and commit.

zones.name: The Oasis
zones.summary: Palm basin — side zone.
tips: The basin rings the water; in, objective, portal.

zones.name: The Foothills
zones.summary: Rising scrubland hub: Tunnel ahead, Boiling Lake aside, waypoint on the way.
tips: Tag the waypoint; the Tunnel mouth sits high — climb toward it.
The Boiling Lake is side content for its quest pickup.

zones.name: The Boiling Lake
zones.summary: Acid lake loop — side zone with the Basilisk.
tips: The Basilisk guards the pickup at the lake's far side; kill, grab, portal.

zones.name: The Tunnel
zones.summary: Mine tunnel carrying an Eternal-lab Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: The trial is on the way — second of the final three.
The tunnel runs through to the Quarry; don't chase side shafts.

zones.name: The Quarry
zones.summary: Terraced quarry hub with waypoint and the act's story doors.
tips: Tag the waypoint; the Refinery is side content, the Belly descent is the main line.
The hub is compact — follow quest markers rather than clearing terraces.

zones.name: The Refinery
zones.summary: Industrial side pocket.
tips: Single quest objective inside — in, kill, out.

zones.name: The Belly of the Beast
zones.summary: Return to the flesh — single level this time.
tips: Descend the gut corridor; the Rotting Core waits below.

zones.name: The Rotting Core
zones.summary: Malachai's remains — the Depraved Trinity finale.
tips: Three arena pods branch off the core; clear the Trinity pod by pod without overstaying in the degen.
Act 10 follows the flask event — nothing to backtrack.

zones.name: The Cathedral Rooftop
zones.summary: Rooftop landing under siege — down into the Square.
tips: Follow the breach line down; the Ravaged Square gate is below.
Density is brutal here — run, don't clear.

zones.name: The Ravaged Square
zones.summary: Oriath's shattered hub — the whole act radiates from here.
tips: Tag the central waypoint first.
Learn the compass: Torched Courts (→ Desecrated Chambers) one way, the Canals (→ Kitava) another, the Ossuary trial off to its own side — wrong doors cost minutes.

zones.name: The Torched Courts
zones.summary: The Courts under fire — route to the Desecrated Chambers.
tips: Aisle rule as ever; the Chambers door is at the far end.

zones.name: The Desecrated Chambers
zones.summary: The sanctum desecrated — Avarius reassembled.
tips: Boss room at depth; after the kill, portal back to the Square rather than walking.

zones.name: The Ossuary
zones.summary: Bone crypt — the final Trial of Ascendancy.
tips: Side trip for the last Eternal trial; wall-hug in, trial, portal out.

zones.name: The Canals
zones.summary: Waterway toward Kitava's harbor, waypoint mid-route.
tips: Follow the water; tag the mid-zone waypoint — it's your boss-retry insurance.

zones.name: The Feeding Trough
zones.summary: Short, nasty run-up to Kitava round two.
tips: Bank a portal before the arena; this Kitava hits like an act boss should.
The kill ends the campaign — Innocence ferries you to Karui Shores.
